body.name: Profiled-normal cross-fit handle
body.construction: Estimate the finite cell probabilities and conditional means on training folds; form the \(J\)-coordinate treated-versus-donor PT map, profile its latent treated-change coordinate with \(A_{\mathrm{PT}}\), and differentiate the resulting PT map and the SC map to obtain foldwise normals. Use the fixed spectral gap to retain common normal coordinates, solve the empirical center \(\mathrm{QP}_x\), and couple its two coefficient blocks through the active-chart extensions in \(\mathrm{def{:}local\text{-}score\text{-}extension}\). Insert the selected foldwise branch-valid score into a held-out one-step update and a common Gaussian-multiplier coupling; the data-driven chart coupling and uniform remainder correction are to be derived in \(\mathrm{oeq{:}uniform\text{-}attainment}\).
